predecessors.name: Dutch Ceylon
predecessors.text: the Dutch coastal provinces, surrendered in February 1796

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Kandy
predecessors.text: the Kingdom of Kandy: the interior of the island not held by the British in 1814

successors.name: Sri Lanka
successors.text: the Dominion of Ceylon, independent on 4 February 1948

ledger.x: 1805: the war ends in a truce.
1815: the Kingdom of Kandy passes to Britain.
1815: the war ends with the Kandyan Convention of 2 March 1815; the Uva Rebellion that began in 1817 is the 'Third Kandyan War' of the page.

wars.name: First Kandyan War
wars.outcome: The British force 'marched to Kandy and found it evacuated' on 31 January 1803 and the attempt 'was repulsed'; 'an uneasy truce was in place by 1805'.

wars.name: Second Kandyan War
wars.outcome: Kandy seized on 14 February 1815 and the king captured on 18 February; the Kandyan Convention of 2 March 1815 ended the kingdom's independence.

wars.name: Uva Rebellion
wars.outcome: The rising 'commencing in the duchy of Uva in 1817' (also called the Third Kandyan War) was put down; the Kandyan leaders were beheaded on 26 November 1817 and the kingdom 'definitively lost its autonomy'.

certainty.note: The frontier with the Kingdom of Kandy was a line of forts and passes, not a surveyed boundary.
An island: the coast is the border.
